mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the permission matrix Allowed set to be empty or contain incorrect mappings. The LeastPrivilege assertion checks that the required role-operation pairs exist; without the fact, these pairs may be missing or incorrect.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { ComplianceReviewer -> DecideApplication in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows applications to transition between statuses without corresponding audit entries. The AuditCompleteness assertion checks that every status change produces exactly one audit entry; without the fact, transitions could occur without audit records.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some app: LoanApplication | app.status = UnderReview and no ae: AuditEntry | ae.application = app and ae.newStatus = UnderReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a customer to have multiple applications simultaneously in Submitted or Under Review status. The FR_008 assertion checks that at most one in-flight application exists per customer; without the fact, multiple in-flight applications would be permitted.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OneInFlightViolation { some disj app1, app2: LoanApplication | app1.customer = app2.customer and (app1.status = Submitted or app1.status = UnderReview) and (app2.status = Submitted or app2.status = UnderReview) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows applications at Under Review, Approved, or Rejected status to have no assigned officer or an officer with wrong role. The FR_012 assertion checks that applications in decision-phase statuses have exactly one assigned loan officer; without the fact, this invariant is violated.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AssignmentConsistencyViolation { some app: LoanApplication | (app.status = UnderReview or app.status = Approved or app.status = Rejected) and app.assignedOfficer = none }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows decisions to be recorded by any user, not just the assigned loan officer. The FR_013 assertion checks that every decision's recorded actor is the application's assigned officer; without the fact, any user could record a decision.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OnlyAssignedOfficerViolation { some dec: Decision | dec.decidedBy != dec.application.assignedOfficer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the compliance reviewer role to be granted write operations (submit, claim, decide). The FR_004 assertion checks that compliance reviewers have no write permissions; without the fact, write permissions could be incorrectly granted to the compliance role.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceWriteViolation { ComplianceReviewer -> DecideApplication in PermMatrix.Allowed }
